profile_text.body:
Course Hero is an online study platform founded in 2006 and headquartered in Redwood City. The company describes itself as offering instant access to millions of study resources, course notes, test prep, 24/7 homework help, and tutors, with the taglines "Own the study hour" and "Get unstuck." It states that it is a Learneo, Inc. business and is not sponsored or endorsed by any college or university.

Its product portfolio includes QuillBot, a paraphrasing tool in the writing and editing category. The company's website also displays sample academic questions on topics such as bond yields, interest rates, and the Dow Jones Industrial Average, consistent with its study resource focus.
